Alexis Mac Allister.note: Mac Allister is Argentina's calm connector under pressure. His extra-time assist against Cabo Verde showed how he keeps seeing the clean pass after the match has become messy.
Alexis Mac Allister.noteZh: 麦卡利斯特是阿根廷压力下的冷静连接点。他对佛得角加时的助攻说明，即使比赛变乱，他仍能看见干净传球。

Cristian Romero.note: Romero sparked Argentina's comeback against Egypt with the first late goal. He is the defender who attacks danger at both ends, sometimes before anyone else has reacted.
Cristian Romero.noteZh: 罗梅罗用第一个后段进球点燃了阿根廷对埃及的逆转。他是会在两端主动攻击危险的后卫，有时比别人反应更早。

Damian Emiliano Martinez.note: Martinez gives Argentina the belief that chaos can still be survived. His tournament card is saves, penalties, and the confidence that changes nervous defenders.
Damian Emiliano Martinez.noteZh: 马丁内斯让阿根廷相信混乱仍能被熬过去。他的赛事卡片是扑救、点球，以及能改变紧张后卫的信心。

Enzo Fernandez.note: Enzo gave Argentina the final punch against Egypt at 90+2. His passing moves the team forward, but his value now also includes arriving when Messi has bent the defense.
Enzo Fernandez.noteZh: 恩佐在对埃及时90+2分钟打出最后一击。他的传球推动球队向前，但现在的价值也包括在梅西拉弯防线后及时到位。

Exequiel Palacios.note: Palacios is Argentina's tidy midfield cover. He is there when the team needs possession to calm down rather than another risky pass toward Messi.
Exequiel Palacios.noteZh: 帕拉西奥斯是阿根廷整洁的中场深度。当球队需要控球降温，而不是再冒险找梅西时，他有价值。

Facundo Medina.note: Medina has been Argentina's left-side defender and already assisted Messi against Austria. He gives aggression at the back plus a first pass that can matter.
Facundo Medina.noteZh: 梅迪纳是阿根廷左侧防守者，也已经在对奥地利时助攻梅西。他既给后场带来侵略性，也有可能送出重要第一传。

Geronimo Rulli.note: Rulli is experienced goalkeeper cover behind Martinez. His job is to be ready if Argentina need a calmer keeper to manage possession spells.
Geronimo Rulli.noteZh: 鲁利是马丁内斯身后的经验门将保障。如果阿根廷需要一名更冷静的门将管理控球阶段，他要随时准备。

Giovani Lo Celso.note: Lo Celso scored in the rotated Jordan match and remains Argentina's left-footed pocket passer. He gives Messi another player who understands the soft space.
Giovani Lo Celso.noteZh: 洛塞尔索在轮换对约旦时进球，依然是阿根廷左脚空当传球手。他给梅西身边再添一个理解柔软空间的人。

Giuliano Simeone.note: Simeone is Argentina's energy forward. He presses like the possession can be won back immediately, then runs the channel before defenders settle.
Giuliano Simeone.noteZh: 小西蒙尼是阿根廷的活力前锋。他压迫时像球马上就能抢回来，然后在防守者站稳前冲击通道。

Gonzalo Montiel.note: Montiel assisted Messi's late winner against Egypt and still carries late-game trust. Argentina know he can survive tense minutes and make one simple pass count.
Gonzalo Montiel.noteZh: 蒙铁尔助攻梅西打进对埃及的后段反超球，也依然承载比赛后段的信任。阿根廷知道他能熬过紧张时刻，并让一次简单传球产生价值。

Jose Manuel Lopez.note: Lopez is Argentina's taller box option. If Switzerland force the game wide, he gives crosses a target and centre-backs a different problem.
Jose Manuel Lopez.noteZh: 洛佩斯是阿根廷更高大的禁区选择。如果瑞士迫使比赛走边路，他会给传中一个目标，也给中卫不同问题。

Juan Musso.note: Musso is experienced goalkeeper depth. He is there for training-ground standards and emergency cover, not as a likely quarter-final storyline.
Juan Musso.noteZh: 穆索是经验门将深度。他的价值是训练标准和紧急保障，而不是八强战很可能出现的主线。

Julian Alvarez.note: Alvarez is Argentina's pressure starter when Messi needs the game tilted around him. He runs first, presses first, and makes defenders play before they are comfortable.
Julian Alvarez.noteZh: 阿尔瓦雷斯是阿根廷为梅西创造环境的压迫起点。他先跑、先压迫，让防守者在还不舒服时就必须处理球。

Lautaro Martinez.note: Lautaro has scored in this tournament and assisted Enzo's late winner against Egypt. He keeps the box occupied while Messi decides where the opening really is.
Lautaro Martinez.noteZh: 劳塔罗这届赛事已经进球，也助攻恩佐打进对埃及的后段制胜球。他占住禁区，让梅西决定真正的空当在哪里。

Leandro Paredes.note: Paredes gives Argentina a deeper passing reset when the midfield gets frantic. He can slow the game before Messi has to solve everything himself.
Leandro Paredes.noteZh: 帕雷德斯在中场变得急躁时给阿根廷更深的传球重置。他能先把比赛放慢，而不是让梅西独自解决一切。

Lionel Messi.note: Messi has carried Argentina through this tournament with goals, assists, and late answers. The pattern is still the same: give him one pocket and the whole match changes shape.
Lionel Messi.noteZh: 梅西用进球、助攻和后段回应带着阿根廷前进。这种模式仍然没变：给他一个空当，整场比赛的形状都会改变。

Lisandro Martinez.note: Lisandro has been both defender and emergency scorer, assisting Messi against Cabo Verde before scoring in extra time. His bite comes with a forward pass.
Lisandro Martinez.noteZh: 利桑德罗既是防守者，也是紧急得分点，对佛得角先助攻梅西再在加时进球。他的硬度还带着向前传球。

Marcos Senesi.note: Senesi is left-sided centre-back cover for Argentina's rotation. He keeps the passing angle alive when the staff want control more than pure aggression.
Marcos Senesi.noteZh: 塞内西是阿根廷轮换中的左侧中卫深度。当教练组想要控制多于纯粹侵略性时，他能保持传球角度。

Nahuel Molina.note: Molina has been Argentina's main right-back in the knockout run. His job is to run beyond De Paul and still recover before counters reach Romero.
Nahuel Molina.noteZh: 莫利纳是阿根廷淘汰赛阶段的主要右后卫。他要在德保罗身前前插，同时在反击到达罗梅罗前回追。

Nico Gonzalez.note: Gonzalez assisted Messi in the opener and remains Argentina's hard-running wide option. He attacks the far post and does the work that keeps the front line balanced.
Nico Gonzalez.noteZh: 尼科·冈萨雷斯在首战助攻梅西，仍是阿根廷高强度跑动的边路选择。他冲击远端，也做保持锋线平衡的工作。

Nico Paz.note: Paz is Argentina's younger creative midfielder for rotation games. He receives between pressure lines and tries to play forward before the safe pass appears.
Nico Paz.noteZh: 尼科·帕斯是阿根廷轮换比赛中的年轻创造型中场。他在压力线之间接球，并试图在安全传球出现前就向前处理。

Nicolas Otamendi.note: Otamendi is veteran defensive authority if Argentina need to close a match. He gives aerial command and the personality to make late minutes feel smaller.
Nicolas Otamendi.noteZh: 如果阿根廷需要收掉比赛，奥塔门迪是老将防守权威。他提供空中控制，也用气场让后段时间显得没那么大。

Nicolas Tagliafico.note: Tagliafico has returned as the safer left-back in the knockout mix. He narrows the defense and lets the midfield take more of the attacking risk.
Nicolas Tagliafico.noteZh: 塔利亚菲科在淘汰赛组合中作为更安全的左后卫回归。他收窄防线，让中场承担更多进攻风险。

Rodrigo De Paul.note: De Paul remains Argentina's running power around Messi, with an assist in the opener and constant cover afterward. He connects the genius to the grind.
Rodrigo De Paul.noteZh: 德保罗依然是梅西身边的跑动力量，首战有助攻，此后不断补位。他把天才和脏活连接起来。

Thiago Almada.note: Almada has started across the attacking midfield line and gives Argentina another set-piece and shooting option. He keeps defenders from loading every answer onto Messi.
Thiago Almada.noteZh: 阿尔马达已经在进攻中场线上多个位置首发，给阿根廷另一名定位球和射门选择。他让防守者不能把所有答案都压到梅西身上。

Valentin Barco.note: Barco is left-footed invention from deeper or wider spaces. He is the change-up if Argentina need a different angle rather than another central combination.
Valentin Barco.noteZh: 巴尔科是在更深或更宽位置提供左脚创造力的人。如果阿根廷需要不同角度，而不是又一次中路配合，他就是变化。
